About.title: About my career
About.description: I hold a Bachelor's degree in Information Systems and have built a multidisciplinary career combining software development (Front-End and Mobile), technical support, and operational management. This integrated background allows me to understand both the technical architecture of systems and the daily realities of administrative workflows, documentation, and compliance.

About.card2_desc: Supervision of healthcare procurement, public contract monitoring, administrative workflows, and vendor relationship management in the public sector.
About.card3_desc: User support, issue diagnosis, root-cause investigation, and continuous maintenance of critical corporate platforms.
About.card4_desc: Proven ability to bridge operational business rules and the technical execution of digital solutions seamlessly.
